about_the_game:
You are trapped in a strange resort, and every night you need to turn on the lights and check the entire room to ensure there is no danger before going to sleep. Once something goes wrong, the long night will loop endlessly.

The danger that follows closely like a shadow

Danger may be hidden in any corner. Do not let go of any weapons, bloodstains, or other dangerous objects that appear. Once danger is discovered, immediately go to the entrance on the first floor and turn off all lights to hide yourself.

Illusion in the Dark

Don't be easily misled by illusions in the dark, be sure to turn on the lights to confirm if there is really any danger. It is not safe to turn off all the lights rashly.

Dealing with danger

If danger is detected, immediately go to the entrance on the first floor and turn off all lights.

Confirm there is no danger, go to the innermost room on the second floor to sleep.

Dangerous entity

When the lights change color, dangerous entities will appear, and you need to immediately evacuate to the entrance on the first floor and turn off all lights.
